messages:
Mia: Heads-up — Novametric just sent a vendor-risk form asking for an EU data residency attestation and a mapping to our SOC2 controls. They said renewal review next week, so we need answers + owner asap.
Sam L: assigned this in the board — can we get a quick owner from security/legal?
Elena: I can start the control mapping. need the exact questions — any bespoke fields?
Mia: mostly standard, but they have a table asking: 'Where is customer data stored, who has access, retention by tenant, and subprocessor list (EU-only)'. also an attestation checkbox they want signed.
Jordan: Legal can sign attestation but we need sec confirmation on subprocessors + KMS key provenance. elena, can you confirm subprocessors and whether we can provide the BYOK note for EU?
Elena: subprocessors: aws-eu (eu-west-1), redis-managed (EU cluster), vectorstore partner (eu partner contract). BYOK: we can provide KMS key origin statement (not the key). I'll draft language.
onboard-bot: Uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/attachments/novametric_riskform_2026.pdf
Sam L: Thanks — I put a 48h SLA on this thread. Mia, can you do the customer-facing summary and send the attestation PDF?
Mia: yes. will prepare a one-pager + attestation. quick Q: do we need a dataflow diagram for this ask?
Elena: only if they ask explicitly. the form's field about "data flow diagram" is optional. i'll attach the standard mini-diagram snippet.
Jordan: I'll pre-approve attestation language. ping me once elena posts subprocessors + KMS provenance line.
Mia: plan: elena to post subprocessors + KMS line by EOD, jordan to approve attestation, sam to review for renewals flag, then i send reply + one-pager to customer.
Sam L: also flagging renewal risk: they mentioned SLA for EU residency as a renewal gating factor. if we can't provide clear attestation they'll escalate to procurement.
Mia: noted — i'll include migration/region roadmap and Dedicated options as mitigation (if they need strict EU tenancy).
Elena: posting the subprocessors snippet now:
```
Subprocessors (EU scope):
- AWS (eu-west-1) - infrastructure
- RedisCloud (eu cluster) - cache
- VectorPartner EU - embeddings store (contracted)
KMS provenance: keys are customer-managed for BYOK customers; for hosted customers we use AWS KMS with CMKs in eu-west-1. We can provide exportable provenance statements, not private key material.
```
Jordan: LGTM on subprocessors language. Mia, you can include that in the attestation.
Mia: draft one-pager and attestation ready — sharing in 10m.
Mia: (uploaded attestation and summary) https://redwood-internal.s3/attachments/novametric_attestation_2026_v1.pdf :thumbsup:
Sam L: i'll add this to the renewal risk tracker and mark as 'response sent' once customer confirms.
Mia: customer reply expected within 48h, will update thread. thanks team :sparkles:
